title: List Of The Committee Members Of The Russian Philatelic Society In China

page_data.en:
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
A & A REGISTRY
D_______

March 18, 1935.

J. Hoff. Esq.,
Secretary,
Russian Philatelic Society in China,
77 Bubbling Well Road,
Shanghai.

I have to acknowledge the receipt of your
letter of March 11, forwarding a list of the Committee
members of the Russian Philatelic Society in China.

I am, Sir,
Your obedient servant,

G. Godfrey Phillips
Deputy Secretary.

EH/PL
page_data.zh:
上海公共租界工部局警务处
A & A 登记处
D_______

1935年3月18日。

J. Hoff 先生，
秘书，
在华俄罗斯集邮协会，
上海静安寺路77号。

兹确认收到您3月11日的来信，随信转来在华俄罗斯集邮协会委员会成员名单。

此致，
敬礼

G. Godfrey Phillips
副秘书。

EH/PL

page_data.en:
13 MAR. 1935
POLICE FORCE with enclosure
M 9/2
S. B. REGI
Russian Philatelic Society
in China.
450 Taku Road.

Secretary,
Shanghai Municipal Council.

Sir,

I have the honour to forward to you the list of
Committee members of the Russian Philatelic Society in China,
for your information.

Please note that all communications to the Society
should be addressed to the Secretary S. Th. Zaeff, 1025/7
Bubbling Well Road.

I have the honour to be,
Sir,
Yours respectfully,
S. Th. Zaeff,
Secretary.
page_data.zh:
1935年3月13日
附函件之警务处
M 9/2
S. B. 登记
在华俄罗斯集邮协会。
大沽路450号。

致：
上海公共租界工部局秘书。

先生：

谨向阁下呈送在华俄罗斯集邮协会委员会成员名单，供阁下知悉。

请注意，凡致该协会之信函，均请寄交秘书 S. Th. Zaeff，地址为静安寺路1025/7号。

此致，
敬礼

S. Th. Zaeff，
秘书。
